codeReview.summary: The feature implementation covers the requested logs-command scope (tail, follow, service filtering, list, rotate integration, and --all archive viewing) with substantial core and CLI unit-test coverage. I found one functional edge-case gap and one related test-coverage gap, both non-blocking for the contracted behavior.

issues.description: The CLI validates `get_log_path(effective_service)` before executing `--all`, so `mlx-stack logs <service> --all` exits with 'No log file found' when only rotated archives exist and the current `.log` is absent. This blocks archive-only viewing even though `read_all_logs()` supports archives without a current log.

CLI tests for `--all` cover the happy path (archives + current) and no-logs error, but do not cover the archive-only case (archives exist, current log missing), leaving the edge-case behavior in `logs.py` untested.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Feature metadata points to `skillName: cli-feature`, but that skill was not available to the worker at runtime, causing repeated manual bypass behavior.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript skeleton for worker session 66eb4f19-206f-4d84-929a-631b19868ab1 shows `Tool: Skill {"skill":"cli-feature"}` followed by `Error: Skill "cli-feature" not found`; handoff.skillFeedback also records this deviation.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The cli-feature skill prescribes test-first (TDD), but this run implemented production files before creating tests, suggesting either procedure drift or insufficient enforcement/clarity.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript skeleton sequence shows `Create src/mlx_stack/core/log_viewer.py` and `Create src/mlx_stack/cli/logs.py` before `Create tests/unit/test_log_viewer.py` and `Create tests/unit/test_cli_logs.py`, while `.factory/skills/cli-feature/SKILL.md` Step 2 requires writing failing tests first.
